facts.claim_en: Alabama reports that its policies require IEP transition planning to begin at an age younger than 16.
facts.claim_es: Alabama informa que sus normas exigen que la planificación de la transición en el IEP empiece antes de los 16 años.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, Alabama IDEA Part B State Performance Plan/Annual Performance Report (FFY 2024)
facts.quote: must meet these requirements at an age younger than 16? YES

facts.claim_en: Alabama's report ties transition planning to 9th grade.
facts.claim_es: El informe de Alabama vincula la planificación de la transición con el noveno grado.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, Alabama IDEA Part B State Performance Plan/Annual Performance Report (FFY 2024)
facts.quote: The State's policies and procedures provide that public agencies must address transition for all students with disabilities entering 9th grade, regardless of their age.

facts.claim_en: In Alabama's federal fiscal year 2024 report, 24,608 of 24,644 youth aged 16 and above with IEPs had IEPs containing every required transition component (99.85%).
facts.claim_es: En el informe del año fiscal federal 2024 de Alabama, 24,608 de 24,644 jóvenes de 16 años o más con IEP tenían un IEP con todos los componentes de transición requeridos (99.85%).
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, Alabama IDEA Part B State Performance Plan/Annual Performance Report (FFY 2024)
facts.quote: Number of youth aged 16 and above with IEPs that contain each of the required components for secondary transition Number of youth with IEPs aged 16 and above FFY 2023 Data FFY 2024 Target FFY 2024 Data Status Slippage 24,608 24,644 99.92% 100% 99.85%

facts.claim_en: Under federal IDEA rules, transition planning must be in the IEP no later than the first IEP in effect when the student turns 16, or earlier if the IEP team decides, and it is updated every year.
facts.claim_es: Según las reglas federales de IDEA, la planificación de la transición debe estar en el IEP a más tardar en el primer IEP vigente cuando el estudiante cumple 16 años, o antes si el equipo del IEP lo decide, y se actualiza cada año.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, IDEA regulations, 34 CFR 300.320
facts.quote: Beginning not later than the first IEP to be in effect when the child turns 16, or younger if determined appropriate by the IEP Team, and updated annually, thereafter
